extra.message: User-supplied search query from request.args.get('search', '') is concatenated directly into a SQL string using an f-string and passed to cursor.execute(). This allows SQL injection attacks, e.g., search=' UNION SELECT username, password FROM users-- can leak data.

User-controlled picture_url from the request payload is fetched via requests.get() without any validation, scheme allow-list, or network restrictions. This is a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability allowing attackers to access internal services, scan local ports, or read local files (e.g., file:///etc/passwd).
